AppleMpsExpectedState.description:

parameters. `Present` carries the requested prerequisite checks, each
optional; with none set it simply asserts the host is a Mac (a hardware

AptRepoExpectedState.description:
Configuration for an APT repository

Manages an APT repository source file in `/etc/apt/sources.list.d/`.
Supports two formats:

**Legacy** (.list): set `repo` to the full one-liner string
  `repo: "deb https://... focal main"`

**Deb822** (.sources): set `types`, `uris`, `suites` (and optionally `components`,
  `signed_by`, `architectures`, `enabled`)

`filename` (without extension) is required in both cases.

CacheUpToDate.description: Whether to run apt-get update after adding/removing repositories

Filename.description: Filename (without extension) for the repository file in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/

Repo.description: Legacy one-liner format → writes to a `.list` file

Types.description: Repository types for deb822 format → writes to a `.sources` file

BindMount.description:
Host directory or file mounted in the container: `source[:target[:ro|rw]]`.

Both paths are absolute, the target defaults to the source and the mount is read-write
unless `ro` is given. Paths can't contain `:`, `,` or whitespace, as the engines use them as
separators.

Manage the service's running state and/or boot enablement

ServiceExpectedState.description:
Configuration for a system service

This enum represents the desired state for a system service, supporting configurations:
- `State`: Manage the service's running state (started/stopped) and/or boot enablement
- `Action`: Manage unconditional actions (restart/reload)

# YAML Representation

## State with enabled:
```yaml
Name: httpd
State: Started
Enabled: true
```

## State only:
```yaml
Name: nginx
State: Started
```

## Enabled only:
```yaml
Name: mysql
Enabled: true
```

## Action only:
```yaml
Name: nginx
Action: Restarted
```

StorageExpectedState.description:
Expected state for storage monitoring on a filesystem or mount point.

When the storage usage breaches the configured [`Threshold`], the optional
cleanup commands are executed one by one to free up space.

Cleanup.description: List of shell commands, executed sequentially, to clean up storage

StorageTarget.description: Target of the storage watch: either a filesystem path or a mount point.

oneOf.description: A filesystem path (e.g. `/`, `/var`).
A mount point path (e.g. `/mnt/data`).

TcpFlag.description:
TCP Flag matching options

Serializes to YAML as `Syn`, `Ack`, `Fin`, `Rst`, `Psh`, `Urg`, `FinRst`, `All`, or `None`.
Displays as `SYN`, `ACK`, `FIN`, `RST`, `PSH`, `URG`, `FIN,RST`, `ALL`, or `NONE` for command
generation via `std::fmt::Display`.

TcpFlagsMatch.description:
TCP flags match specification (-m tcp --tcp-flags)

`mask` specifies which flags to check, and `comp` specifies which of those must be set.

Threshold.description:
Threshold that triggers the storage watch when breached.

Values are compared against `df --output=pcent,used,avail` results.
`used` and `avail` are expressed in 1K blocks.

oneOf.description: `PercentUsed(95)` triggers when 95% or more of the storage is used
Trigger when the used space (in 1K blocks, from `df --output=used`) is greater than or equal to this value.
Trigger when the percentage of the remaining available space is less than or equal to this value.
Trigger when the remaining available space (in 1K blocks, from `df --output=avail`) is less than or equal to this value.
